CLI/integration tests use a loopback mock; no real pretrained weights were run.

items.title: Memo × MemoryOS2 × Hexis canonical temporal and revision integration
items.evidence: MemoryOS2 restore selects current records independent of row order; revisions use lineage-scoped IDs and idempotent no-op correction; expired rows preserve their identity; Hexis temporal lookup/diff delegates to canonical MemoryOS2 and its default review uses recent active memories. Tested through snapshot/restore and OrganismCore integration. WorkPass30 adds source provenance integration inside the same canonical owner, without a second writable store.

items.title: Independent-source provenance trail integrated into canonical MemoryOS2
items.evidence: WorkPass30 retains up to eight independent evidence lineages inside each canonical memory plus a bounded 32-key replay guard. The OrganismCore research bridge uses EvidenceFirewall-derived sourceLineageKey rather than treating every serving host as independent; same-lineage mirrors do not increase corroboration/confidence, distinct lineages merge into the same memory, and snapshot/restore preserves the trail and byte accounting. Runtime Atlas inspector exposes lineage counts/trail. WorkPass31 preserves those source-lineage fields while bringing write/update operations through the single lifecycle gateway.

items.title: Replay-safe canonical memory lifecycle mutation gateway
items.evidence: WorkPass31 routes encode, epistemic status, content correction, signal/context updates and forgetting through MemoryFabric.applyLifecycleCommand. A capped 512-entry persisted receipt journal suppresses exact retries after snapshot/restore, emits no duplicate events, rejects changed-payload command-ID collisions, and is retained/sanitized by migratePersistedOrganism; compatibility ingest/restore, Hexis and external-research write paths use the gateway.

items.title: Optional local embedding retrieval integrated into canonical MemoryOS2 and Runtime Atlas
items.evidence: LocalEmbeddingProvider supports Ollama /api/embed and llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings, bounded normalized cache, endpoint security and failure fallback. MemoryOS2 progressively indexes a bounded derived vector cache, ranks semantic candidates, and Runtime Atlas exposes diagnostics. Live model inference and independent holdout uplift remain separate open gates.
